description: This source file defines the Flutter frontend for a Tic Tac Toe game. It includes the main application setup, theming, game state management, UI components such as the game board, header, and control buttons, and logic for handling user interactions and game rules.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up the app theme and routing, and builds the main game page.

classes.name: GamePage
classes.description: Stateful widget managing the overall game state, UI layout, and interactions.

classes.name: _Header
classes.description: Stateless widget displaying the game title, current player, or winner status.

classes.name: _BoardCard
classes.description: Stateless widget providing styled container for the game board.

classes.name: GameBoard
classes.description: Displays the Tic Tac Toe 3x3 grid, handles tap interactions, and highlights the winning line.

classes.name: _Tile
classes.description: Stateful widget representing each cell in the grid, with animated effects and tap handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the app, runs the root widget.

methods.name: _oceanScheme
methods.description: Defines the custom Ocean Professional color palette for theming.

methods.name: _theme
methods.description: Creates the ThemeData object using the color scheme and style customizations.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the root app widget.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state to initial conditions.

methods.name: _handleTap
methods.description: Handles user taps on the game board cells, updating game state and checking for win/draw.

methods.name: _checkGameState
methods.description: Checks if a player has won or if the game is a draw.
